definitions.explanation: An amount or degree that is neither too much nor too little; just right. Often used when discussing health, exercise, or consumption.

examples.japanese: {適度|てきど}な{運動|うんどう}は{健康|けんこう}に{良|よ}い。
examples.english: Moderate exercise is good for your health.

examples.japanese: {適度|てきど}に{休憩|きゅうけい}を{取|と}ってください。
{塩分|えんぶん}は{適度|てきど}に{摂|と}ることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to consume salt in moderation.

notes:
USAGE: {適度|てきど} is commonly used with topics related to health, lifestyle, and balance. It suggests an optimal middle ground.

FORMS:
・{適度|てきど}な〜 (moderate ~, appropriate ~) - na-adjective
・{適度|てきど}に (moderately, in moderation) - adverbial
・{適度|てきど} (moderation, proper degree) - noun

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{適度|てきど}な{運動|うんどう} (moderate exercise)
・{適度|てきど}な{睡眠|すいみん} (adequate sleep)
・{適度|てきど}な{緊張|きんちょう} (appropriate tension)
・{適度|てきど}な{距離|きょり} (appropriate distance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{程|ほど}よい - just right, moderate (more casual)
・{適切|てきせつ} - appropriate, suitable (more formal)
・{適当|てきとう} - suitable; also 'random/half-hearted' (be careful with context)
